descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group , Leader in IT and Engineering Consulting . We develop innovative and durable technical solutions that fulfill the needs of our local and international partners.
 Responsibilities: 
Develop visually rich websites and interactive pages, including editorial experiences, campaign sites, and immersive digital stories.
Create purposeful motion, transitions, scroll-based animations, and micro-interactions using tools such as GSAP, alongside native browser capabilities.
Build interactive 3D and WebGL experiences using Three.js or comparable technologies.
Collaborate with designers from concept through delivery, shaping ideas, prototyping interactions, and assessing technical feasibility.
Translate designs into responsive interfaces with close attention to typography, composition, spacing, and visual detail.
Optimize animation, rendering, and asset loading to deliver smooth experiences across desktop and mobile devices.
Ensure accessibility is integral to the experience, including keyboard navigation, reduced-motion preferences, and suitable alternatives to complex visual interactions.
Build reusable components and motion patterns that help teams deliver consistent experiences efficiently.
Maintain production-quality code through testing, code reviews, documentation, and sound architectural decisions.
Mentor other developers and help raise the quality of frontend engineering and creative execution.
 Requirements: 
Significant professional experience in frontend development, with ownership of complex websites or digital experiences from concept to production.
A strong portfolio demonstrating highly visual web pages, sophisticated motion, and interactive experiences.
Excellent knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS, and responsive design.
Strong practical experience with GSAP and Three.js, including knowing when simpler CSS or native browser techniques are more appropriate.
Strong experience with Angular, including integrating rich animation and interactive visual experiences into maintainable, component-based applications. Experience with other frontend frameworks, such as React or Vue, is also valued.
A well-developed understanding of animation principles, including timing, easing, sequencing, and how motion supports usability and storytelling.
 Strong performance debugging skills, including identifying rendering bottlenecks and managing the cost of imagery, video, animation, and 3D assets. 
Experience integrating content management systems and APIs into production websites.
The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues across design, content, product, and engineering.
Experience with interactive data visualisation for the web would be an advantage.
